errors.description: The tip magnified 3x: both leaves still taper to a single converging vertex, softened only by a 6-8px edge radius. There is no flat terminal facet and no pair of corners. Held against the fashion-point-58 tip at identical magnification the two terminations are the SAME construction; the only difference is the radius on the very last pixel.
errors.expected: A flat squared terminal edge closing off each leaf - two distinct corners with a straight run of finished edge between them, as the label 'Small Square 5.0 cm', the description and spec.forbidden all require
errors.actual: A tapering point with a rounded apex - reads as a short point collar, not a square collar
errors.correction: Terminate each leaf with a straight flat edge about 10 mm long running square across the leaf axis, so the outer edge and the front edge each meet that flat at a crisp corner and the finished edgestitch turns two right-angle corners at the end of the leaf.

errors.description: Apex (452,600); left tip (222,833), right tip (650,838). Half-widths 230px left against 198 right, a 14 percent difference; tips differ 5px in height; half-angles 44.4 against 40.0.
errors.actual: Left leaf 4.4 degrees wider and 32px further out than the right
errors.correction: Mirror both leaf front edges about the placket centreline at 42 degrees each so the two tips land at equal offset and equal height.

errors.description: Frame scale is inconsistent with the sibling renders: this collar's centre-front height is 405px against 333-368 in the others, so the shorter 5.0 cm leaf is photographed LARGER and the length difference against Square 6.5 cm partly cancels in a side-by-side.
errors.expected: Matched framing across the collar family so leaf length is comparable option to option
errors.actual: Collar sits about 15 percent larger in frame than the 6.5 cm siblings
errors.correction: Hold camera distance and collar-in-frame height constant across the whole collar set so the drawn length differences survive a side-by-side comparison.

notes:
Half the named defect is fixed - the leaves are no longer too long. The DEFINING half is not: the tips are still points.

BLUEPRINT LIMIT, stated rather than resolved: at 232x244 (roughly 1px = 3.5 mm) a 10 mm squared facet would occupy under 3px, and the drawing's tip is a 2-3px anti-aliased convergence, so the ILLUSTRATION CANNOT SETTLE square versus point and no claim is made that it shows one. Everything else in the record - label, description, spec.forbidden - is unambiguous that this is a squared termination, and that is the sole feature separating this option from the point family. The render communicates none of it.

Against Square 6.5 cm the two remain separable by leaf length (0.81 against 1.04, a wider gap than the drawings' 0.76 against 0.87), so the pair is not indistinguishable - but both fail the same way on tip shape and neither reads as 'square' to a customer.
